proposals.name: candidate_set_consensus_density_source_v1
proposals.runtime_definition: For candidate k at the current tick, compute a finite nonnegative outlierness coefficient from the current DP candidate set only, for example the RMS distance between candidate k's ego positions and the per-horizon robust candidate-set center, or a predeclared nearest-neighbor dispersion variant. Missing or nonfinite candidate positions fail closed before selector promotion.
proposals.candidate_shape: one scalar coefficient per DP candidate at one planning tick
non_equivalence_evidence: not temporal_consistency because it uses no previous selected plan or stateful planning memory
not external_context or signal_right_of_way because it uses no traffic-light phase, right-of-way, route-speed, or map-control timing
not route_topology or progress_lane_hard because it uses no map route progress, lane boundary relation, stopline, or crosswalk geometry
not observable_interaction because it uses no NPC, obstacle, TTC, clearance, or conflict-zone state
not DP-prior or top1_retention because it uses no hidden DP log probability, denoising residual, candidate rank, or candidate index
not postprocess_tracker_descriptor because it does not compare raw and postprocessed versions of the same candidate
not mode_seeking candidate-generation control because it does not alter K, noise, anchors, or DP sampling; it is a deterministic coefficient computed after the fixed candidate set is produced
proposals.math_note: The coefficient is nonnegative by distance construction. If later accepted as an atom, it enters CAMP as a fixed current-tick candidate coefficient a_k. CAMP scoring remains score_k(w)=a_k^T w, and simplex/CVaR/L2 optimization over w remains convex. This proposal is not safety evidence and does not authorize replay, training, online selection, Full36, formal seeds, DP modification, or a DP-side classical Benders claim.
